events.strDescriptionEN: The Los Angeles Rams and San Francisco 49ers open their 2026 NFL seasons with a historic NFC West showdown at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, the first regular-season NFL game ever played in Australia. Matthew Stafford and the Rams enter among the league’s leading contenders, while San Francisco arrive with Christian McCaffrey, Brock Purdy, George Kittle and a returning Nick Bosa looking to start the season by beating a familiar divisional rival on an unprecedented international stage.

events.strEvent: Washington Commanders vs Indianapolis Colts
events.strFilename: NFL 2026-10-04 Washington Commanders vs Indianapolis Colts
events.strDescriptionEN: The Washington Commanders and Indianapolis Colts bring the NFL to London for a Week 4 matchup at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, opening the league’s three-game run in the British capital. Washington will serve as the designated home team as both franchises look to make an early-season statement on the international stage. The Commanders arrive with Jayden Daniels at the centre of an offense built around his dual-threat ability, while Indianapolis will hope its quarterback situation and offensive playmakers can generate consistency against Washington’s defense. With the unique atmosphere of Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and both teams crossing the Atlantic for an uncommon interconference meeting, the first London game of the 2026 season adds an extra layer of intrigue to an already important early-season contest.

events.strEvent: Jacksonville Jaguars vs Philadelphia Eagles
events.strFilename: NFL 2026-10-11 Jacksonville Jaguars vs Philadelphia Eagles
events.strDescriptionEN: The Jacksonville Jaguars and Philadelphia Eagles meet at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in one of the marquee games of the 2026 NFL International Series. Jacksonville return to their established second home in London after winning the AFC South with a 13-4 record last season, while Philadelphia arrive as another 2025 division champion and one of the NFC’s most recognizable contenders. The matchup brings together two high-profile quarterbacks in Trevor Lawrence and Jalen Hurts, with Saquon Barkley and Jacksonville’s developing offensive core providing additional star power. Philadelphia have won both of their previous regular-season games outside the United States, including a 24-18 victory over Jacksonville at Wembley in 2018, while the Jaguars possess unrivalled experience playing in London. With both teams carrying playoff expectations and an international spotlight on Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, the Week 5 matchup represents one of the most significant games on the 2026 London schedule.
